errors.description: The final exponential-divisibility remark is false as stated: primes absent from every initial number could occur in d with arbitrary positive exponent, since that exponent divides 0. Restricting d to primes dividing an initial entry repairs it.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: The actual proof is complete and correct. Termination follows from the bounded numbers of product-decreasing and one-producing moves, and the prime-wise gcd-of-valuations invariant uniquely determines the terminal value. The error is confined to an unnecessary concluding remark.
